description: This file contains helper functions for checking validity of OFDM symbol indices and U-Plane PRB fields within the ocudu project, specifically related to uplink control-plane context and user-plane sections.

methods.name: is_symbol_index_in_cplane_valid
methods.description: Checks if an OFDM symbol index is valid within the uplink control-plane context.

methods.name: are_uplane_prb_fields_valid
methods.description: Validates all U-Plane PRB fields in the results against the control-plane context and logs issues.
